items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: The soup smells deliciously, so I am very hungry.
His idea sounds like a joke to me.
The leaves turned red and fell from the trees.
My little brother grew taller than my father this year.
The medicine tasted bitter, so she drank water.
items.exp: 감각동사 smell 뒤에는 부사가 아니라 형용사가 와야 해서 deliciously는 delicious가 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: My mom became angrily when she saw my room.
The dog looks like happy after the walk.
The idea sounds like a good plan to me.
His voice on the phone sounded angrily.
items.exp: sound like 뒤에는 명사가 올 수 있어요. 나머지는 became angry, looks happy, sounded angry, smells sweet처럼 형용사 보어가 필요해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
choices: Her answer sounded correct to everyone.
You will feel better after a long sleep.
The soup is getting cold, so eat it now.
It looks a perfect day for a picnic.
My sister grew angry when I used her phone.
items.exp: 감각동사 look 뒤에 명사가 오면 look like를 써야 해서 'looks like a perfect day'가 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 감각동사의 쓰임이 틀린 문장은?
choices: The old man looked at the photo and felt sad.
The boy sounds like a grown-up when he talks.
The twins look alike, but their voices sound different.
I feel like tired today, so I will go to bed early.
items.exp: like 뒤에는 명사가 오고, 형용사 보어 앞에는 like를 쓰지 않아요. 'feel like tired'는 'feel tired'가 되어야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The air got cooler after the sun went down.
(b) This dress looks like beautiful on you.
(c) Your plan sounds interesting, but it is too expensive.
(d) The children became quiet and listened to the teacher.
(e) The pie smells sweetly, so everyone wants a piece.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: get + 형용사(비교급)는 알맞아요. (b) 틀림: 형용사 앞에는 like를 쓰지 않아서 looks beautiful이 되어야 해요. (c) 옳음: sound + 형용사예요. (d) 옳음: become + 형용사예요. (e) 틀림: 감각동사 smell 뒤에는 형용사 sweet을 써야 해요. 따라서 옳은 문장은 (a), (c), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) She became like a nurse after ten years.
(b) The tomatoes grew big in the garden.
(c) My father became a pilot when he was young.
(d) The monster in the movie looked scarily.
(e) The song sounds like a lullaby, and the baby looks sleepy.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: become 뒤에 명사가 오면 like 없이 became a nurse로 써야 해요. (b) 옳음: grow + 형용사는 알맞아요. (c) 옳음: become + 명사예요. (d) 틀림: look 뒤에는 형용사 scary를 써야 해요. (e) 옳음: sound like + 명사, look + 형용사 모두 알맞아요. 따라서 틀린 문장은 (a), (d) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The teacher looked at the test paper carefully.
(b) The teacher looked carefully at the test paper.
(c) My brother turned pale when he heard the news.
(d) Your answer sounds correctly to me.
(e) Mina became president of the student council last year.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: look at은 1형식이고 carefully는 동작을 꾸미는 부사라 알맞아요. (b) 옳음: 부사의 위치만 다를 뿐 올바른 문장이에요. (c) 옳음: turn + 형용사(~해지다)예요. (d) 틀림: 감각동사 sound 뒤에는 형용사 correct를 써야 해요. (e) 옳음: become + 명사(직책)에는 관사가 없어도 돼요. 따라서 옳은 문장은 (a), (b), (c), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The milk smells like sour, so do not drink it.
(b) After the long trip, we all felt exhausted.
(c) The sky turned dark, and it began to rain.
(d) His excuse sounded like a lie to me.
(e) She looked happily when she opened the gift.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 형용사 앞에는 like를 쓰지 않아서 smells sour예요. (b) 옳음: feel + 형용사예요. (c) 옳음: turn + 형용사예요. (d) 옳음: sound like + 명사예요. (e) 틀림: look 뒤에는 형용사 happy가 와야 해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (b), (c), (d)이에요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The man at the door looks a police officer.
(b) This pasta tastes great with garlic.
(c) The students grew nervous before the exam.
(d) That sounds like a wonderful idea!
(e) The room became warmly after we turned on the heater.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 명사 앞에는 look like를 써야 해요. (b) 옳음: taste + 형용사예요. (c) 옳음: grow + 형용사(~해지다)예요. (d) 옳음: sound like + 명사예요. (e) 틀림: become 뒤에는 형용사 warm을 써야 해요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (a), (e)이에요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) You look tired. Did you sleep well?
(b) The kitten feels like soft in my hands.
(c) The baby grew sleepy and closed her eyes.
(d) The cookies smell like chocolate and taste sweet.
(e) These shoes feel comfortable on my feet.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: look + 형용사이고 well은 동작을 꾸미는 부사예요. (b) 틀림: 형용사 앞에는 like가 필요 없어서 feels soft예요. (c) 옳음: grow + 형용사예요. (d) 옳음: smell like + 명사, taste + 형용사예요. (e) 옳음: feel + 형용사예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d), (e)이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Your idea (A) a good plan, and it (B) very exciting.
items.exp: (A) 뒤에 명사구가 오므로 sounds like, (B) 뒤에 형용사구가 오므로 sounds를 써요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
The soup got (A) as it cooked, and the kitchen smelled (B).
items.exp: get과 smell 뒤에는 주격보어로 형용사가 와요. like는 형용사 앞에 쓰지 않아요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 grow의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> The days [grow] longer in spring.
choices: My uncle [grows] apples on his farm.
items.exp: <보기>는 grow + 형용사 보어(2형식)예요. 정답이 같은 2형식이고, 나머지는 목적어를 가지는 3형식이거나 부사가 붙은 1형식이에요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 get의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> It [gets] dark early in winter.
choices: She [got] a new bike for her birthday.
I will [get] some water for you.
My sister [got] angry at the noise.
items.exp: <보기>는 get + 형용사 보어(~해지다)로 2형식이에요. 정답만 get + 형용사이고, 나머지는 '얻다, 받다'의 3형식이거나 부사어가 붙은 1형식이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 노래는 슬픈 이야기처럼 들린다.
items.exp: 명사구 a sad story가 이어지므로 sounds like를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 너무 오래 서 있었더니 다리가 무겁게 느껴졌다.
items.s: My legs ___ after standing for so long.
items.exp: feel 뒤에는 형용사 heavy를 쓰고 시제는 과거예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 날씨가 점점 따뜻해지고 있다.
items.exp: get + 형용사의 현재진행형이에요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.exp: become 뒤에는 부사가 아니라 형용사 보어가 와요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.exp: 형용사 앞에는 like를 쓰지 않아요.

items.q: 괄호 안의 단어를 어법에 맞는 품사로 바꿔 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: The medicine tasted ___, but it made me feel better.
items.exp: taste 뒤에는 형용사 보어가 오므로 명사 bitterness를 형용사 bitter로 바꿔요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: I asked a favor to my neighbor last week.
My aunt cooked us a big dinner on my birthday.
He bought a new scarf for his sister yesterday.
The guide showed the map to the tourists.
Mr. Lee teaches English to the first-year students.
items.exp: ask는 3형식으로 바꿀 때 전치사 of를 써서 'asked a favor of my neighbor'가 되어야 해요. 나머지는 cook/buy는 for, show/teach는 to를 바르게 썼어요.

items.q: 다음 중 어순이나 전치사가 틀린 문장은?
choices: Dad will make a wooden toy for his son.
The clerk gave the customer a receipt.
I will bring some water to the players.
Jane sent a postcard me from Paris.
She told the secret to nobody.
items.exp: 4형식은 ‘간접목적어 + 직접목적어’, 3형식은 ‘직접목적어 + to + 간접목적어’ 순서예요. 'sent a postcard me'는 'sent me a postcard' 또는 'sent a postcard to me'가 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: He explained me the rule of the game.
She said us a funny story.
My uncle bought a bike to me.
Can you get a ticket to me?
The waiter brought us two glasses of water.
items.exp: explain, say는 간접목적어를 바로 받는 4형식으로 쓸 수 없어요. buy와 get은 3형식 전환 시 for를 써야 하므로 to는 틀려요. bring은 4형식으로 쓸 수 있어요.

items.q: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: Mom bought [me a pair of shoes] last week.
I showed [my passport to the officer].
He gave [a gift to his teacher] at the party.
The teacher asked [a hard question of us].
items.exp: 4형식은 ‘간접목적어 + 직접목적어’ 순서라 'find me a pen'이 되거나, 3형식 'find a pen for me'가 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 문장 전환이 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: He sent me a gift. = He sent a gift to me.
She made him a cake. = She made a cake for him.
Mom found me a cheap hotel. = Mom found a cheap hotel to me.
I asked her a question. = I asked a question of her.
Mr. Kim taught us music. = Mr. Kim taught music to us.
items.exp: find는 3형식으로 전환할 때 for를 써서 'found a cheap hotel for me'가 되어야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) My dad cooked the family a special dinner.
(b) The guide showed to the tourists the old castle.
(c) I will give a nice present to you on your birthday.
(d) The reporter asked many questions for the mayor.
(e) The nurse got a blanket to the patient.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: cook은 4형식으로 쓸 수 있어요. (b) 틀림: showed the old castle to the tourists 또는 showed the tourists the old castle이어야 해요. (c) 옳음: give는 3형식에서 to를 써요. (d) 틀림: ask는 3형식에서 of를 써서 of the mayor가 되어야 해요. (e) 틀림: get은 3형식에서 for를 써서 for the patient가 되어야 해요. 따라서 옳은 문장은 (a), (c) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) He sent the letter to his pen pal in Canada.
(b) She bought a new backpack to her son.
(c) Mom made a sandwich to me and gave a juice to my brother.
(d) The coach showed the new players the locker room.
(e) Please find a pen to me; I lost mine.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: send는 3형식에서 to를 써요. (b) 틀림: buy는 for를 써서 for her son이 되어야 해요. (c) 틀림: make는 for를 써서 for me가 되어야 해요. (d) 옳음: show는 4형식으로 쓸 수 있어요. (e) 틀림: find는 for를 써서 for me가 되어야 해요. 따라서 틀린 문장은 (b), (c), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Her grandmother knitted her a warm sweater.
(b) My teacher showed our class a video about whales.
(c) He lent his phone me.
(d) Dad asked the waiter a question about the menu.
(e) Ms. Han told the kids a bedtime story.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 4형식 ‘간접목적어 + 직접목적어’ 순서가 맞아요. (b) 옳음: show는 4형식으로 쓸 수 있어요. (c) 틀림: 간접목적어가 앞에 와서 lent me his phone이어야 해요. (d) 옳음: ask는 4형식으로도 쓸 수 있어요. (e) 옳음: tell은 4형식으로 쓸 수 있어요. 따라서 옳은 문장은 (a), (b), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Mr. Kim gave to us a lot of homework.
(b) My brother cooked ramyeon for me last night.
(c) She asked her teacher a hard question.
(d) I bought a gift of my best friend.
(e) Please show your ticket to the guard.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: gave a lot of homework to us 또는 gave us a lot of homework이어야 해요. (b) 옳음: cook은 3형식에서 for를 써요. (c) 옳음: ask는 4형식으로 쓸 수 있어요. (d) 틀림: buy는 for를 써서 for my best friend여야 해요. (e) 옳음: show는 3형식에서 to를 써요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (b), (c), (e)이에요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Dad made me a toy robot for my birthday.
(b) Can you bring a cup of tea to me?
(c) He told a lie of his parents.
(d) The waiter got a table for us near the window.
(e) They sent an invitation us.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: make는 4형식으로 쓸 수 있어요. (b) 옳음: bring은 3형식에서 to를 써요. (c) 틀림: tell은 to를 써서 to his parents가 되어야 해요. (d) 옳음: get은 3형식에서 for를 써요. (e) 틀림: sent us an invitation 또는 sent an invitation to us여야 해요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (e)이에요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The coach taught us how to swim.
(b) She found a nice jacket for me at the store.
(c) I will write an e-mail to the manager tonight.
(d) My uncle made a table to his daughter.
(e) Could I ask a favor of you?
items.exp: (a) 옳음: teach + 간접목적어 + how to ~ 형태가 알맞아요. (b) 옳음: find는 3형식에서 for를 써요. (c) 옳음: write는 to를 써요. (d) 틀림: make는 for를 써서 for his daughter여야 해요. (e) 옳음: ask는 3형식에서 of를 써요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (e)이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Brian bought a ticket (A) his sister and sent a text message (B) his mom.
items.exp: buy는 for, send는 to를 써서 3형식으로 전환해요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
He asked an odd question (A) me, made a card (B) me, and sent it (C) my sister.
items.exp: ask는 of, make는 for, send는 to를 써요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
She cooked (A) a big dinner, and she sent a postcard (B) my dad.
items.exp: 4형식에서는 전치사 없이 ‘간접목적어 + 직접목적어’ 순서이므로 'cooked us a big dinner'예요. send는 3형식에서 to를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 아빠는 나에게 오래된 시계를 사 주셨다.
items.exp: 4형식은 ‘동사 + 간접목적어 + 직접목적어’ 순서라 bought me an old watch예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 의사는 환자들에게 간단한 질문을 하나 했다.
items.hint: (ask, a simple question, the patients) 활용, of 사용, 7단어
a: asked a simple question of the patients
items.exp: ask는 3형식으로 쓸 때 전치사 of를 써요.

items.q: 다음 문장을 3형식으로 바꿔 쓰세요.
items.s: Lisa made her friends some muffins. → Lisa made ___.
items.exp: make는 3형식 전환 시 for를 써요.

items.q: 다음 문장을 3형식으로 바꿔 쓰세요.
items.s: Mr. Park will teach us math next year. → Mr. Park will teach ___ next year.
items.exp: teach는 3형식 전환 시 to를 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.exp: 4형식은 ‘간접목적어 + 직접목적어’, 3형식은 ‘직접목적어 + to + 간접목적어’ 순서예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 소년은 아빠에게 그림 한 장을 보여 드렸다.
a: showed a picture to his dad
items.exp: show를 3형식으로 쓰면 ‘직접목적어 + to + 간접목적어’ 순서가 돼요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: She let her little brother to play with her toys.
The news made everyone in the room silent.
My coach advised me to stop eating sweets.
We heard a dog barking outside the window.
items.exp: 사역동사 let은 목적격보어로 동사원형을 써서 'let her little brother play'가 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: The teacher made the students to clean the classroom.
I want you being honest with me.
My parents allowed me go to the concert.
Dad had me wash his car on Sunday.
items.exp: have는 사역동사라 동사원형 wash를 써요. 나머지는 made ... clean, want ... to be, made me sad, allowed me to go로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 get, help, 지각동사 문장에서 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: She got her brother help her with the project.
The coach got the players to run ten laps.
He helped his sister carry the heavy bags.
I felt something crawl up my leg.
We watched the children fly kites in the park.
items.exp: get은 목적격보어로 to부정사를 써서 'got her brother to help'가 되어야 해요. help는 원형과 to부정사가 모두 가능해요.

items.q: 다음 중 목적격보어의 형태가 틀린 문장은?
choices: His jokes always make us laugh.
The door was open, so I left it open.
Please keep the baby warmly under the blanket.
People call that tall building the Sky Tower.
The teacher told us not to run in the hall.
items.exp: keep의 목적격보어에는 부사가 아니라 형용사가 와서 'keep the baby warm'이 되어야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The coach made the players run in the rain.
(b) My mom told me do the dishes.
(c) The song made her feel lonely.
(d) I saw a man to enter the bank.
(e) He asked the waiter to bring some water.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 사역동사 make 뒤에는 동사원형이 와요. (b) 틀림: tell은 to부정사를 써서 told me to do가 되어야 해요. (c) 옳음: make + 목적어 + 동사원형이에요. (d) 틀림: 지각동사 see 뒤에는 동사원형이나 -ing를 써서 enter 또는 entering이어야 해요. (e) 옳음: ask + 목적어 + to부정사예요. 따라서 옳은 문장은 (a), (c), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) The noise kept me awake all night.
(b) She helped me to find my lost key.
(c) The doctor advised him exercise more.
(d) We named our puppy Coco.
(e) Mr. Kim will not let his son goes out at night.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: keep + 목적어 + 형용사예요. (b) 옳음: help는 목적격보어로 to부정사도 쓸 수 있어요. (c) 틀림: advise는 to부정사를 써서 advised him to exercise가 되어야 해요. (d) 옳음: name + 목적어 + 명사예요. (e) 틀림: 사역동사 let 뒤에는 동사원형 go를 써야 해요. 따라서 틀린 문장은 (c), (e) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Mom had my little sister take a nap.
(b) The movie made me to cry a lot.
(c) I smelled something burning in the kitchen.
(d) They expect him to win the race.
(e) Do not leave the door open when it rains.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: have + 목적어 + 동사원형이에요. (b) 틀림: 사역동사 make 뒤에는 동사원형 cry가 와요. (c) 옳음: 지각동사 뒤에 -ing를 쓸 수 있어요. (d) 옳음: expect + 목적어 + to부정사예요. (e) 옳음: leave + 목적어 + 형용사예요. 따라서 옳은 문장은 (a), (c), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The teacher allowed us to use dictionaries.
(b) I found the movie very boring.
(c) She had her assistant to call the client.
(d) We watched the sun sink behind the hills.
(e) He told me do not touch the machine.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: allow + 목적어 + to부정사예요. (b) 옳음: find + 목적어 + 형용사예요. (c) 틀림: have는 동사원형을 써서 call이어야 해요. (d) 옳음: 지각동사 + 목적어 + 동사원형이에요. (e) 틀림: tell은 to부정사를 쓰고 부정은 not to touch예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)이에요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The kids saw the clown juggling balls.
(b) The sad story made the audience cry.
(c) My teacher got me to join the speech contest.
(d) His kindness made me happily.
(e) The rule does not allow students use phones.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 지각동사 + 목적어 + -ing가 가능해요. (b) 옳음: make + 목적어 + 동사원형이에요. (c) 옳음: get + 목적어 + to부정사예요. (d) 틀림: make의 목적격보어에는 형용사 happy가 와야 해요. (e) 틀림: allow는 to부정사를 써서 allow students to use예요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (d), (e)이에요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) They called their baby girl Lucy.
(b) Jina helped me cleaning the windows.
(c) The wind made the door to shut loudly.
(d) I want my brother to be kind to others.
(e) She let the dog to sleep on the sofa.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: call + 목적어 + 명사예요. (b) 틀림: help 뒤에는 동사원형이나 to부정사를 써서 clean 또는 to clean이어야 해요. (c) 틀림: 사역동사 make 뒤에는 동사원형 shut이 와요. (d) 옳음: want + 목적어 + to부정사예요. (e) 틀림: let 뒤에는 동사원형 sleep이 와요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (d)이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Mom told me (A) the room and made my brother (B) the dishes.
items.exp: tell은 to부정사(to clean), 사역동사 make는 동사원형(wash)을 목적격보어로 써요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
The singer made the fans (A) with joy, and everyone heard her (B) a new song.
items.exp: make는 동사원형(scream)을 쓰고, 지각동사 hear 뒤에는 동사원형(sing)이나 -ing를 써요. to부정사는 쓸 수 없어요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 부분의 문형이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> People called him [a genius].
choices: Mom made me [a cup of cocoa].
items.exp: <보기>는 목적어(him) = 목적격보어(a genius)인 5형식이에요. elected Mr. Cho mayor도 Mr. Cho = mayor인 5형식이고, 나머지는 '~에게 ~을 해 주다'의 4형식이에요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 made의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> The rain [made] the road slippery.
choices: We [made] it to the station on time.
The coach [made] the team run fast.
items.exp: <보기>는 make + 목적어 + 보어의 5형식이에요. 정답은 make + 목적어 + 동사원형의 5형식이고, 나머지는 4형식, 3형식, 1형식이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 엄마는 내게 내 방을 청소하라고 말씀하셨다.
a: told me to clean my room
items.exp: tell은 목적격보어로 to부정사를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 영화는 우리를 아주 슬프게 만들었다.
items.exp: make + 목적어 + 형용사 구조예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 그가 문을 닫는 소리를 들었다.
items.exp: 지각동사 hear 뒤에는 동사원형이나 -ing를 목적격보어로 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.exp: 사역동사 make의 목적격보어는 동사원형이에요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.exp: allow의 목적격보어는 to부정사예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 오빠가 숙제를 도와주도록 시켰다.
items.hint: get 사용, my brother, help me 포함, 6단어
a: got my brother to help me
items.exp: get은 목적격보어로 to부정사를 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Mr. Han has taught math at our school three years ago.
My sister has already finished her homework.
They have lived in Daegu since 2015.
Have you ever eaten Indian food?
items.exp: three years ago처럼 명확한 과거를 나타내는 말은 현재완료와 함께 쓸 수 없어서 'taught' 또는 'has taught ... for three years'가 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: When have you met your English teacher?
She has wrote five letters to him this year.
I haven't see him since last Friday.
Did you have finished the report?
Where has your brother been since last night?
items.exp: since last night은 현재완료와 함께 써요. 나머지는 When did you meet, has written, haven't seen, Did you finish로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 시제가 어색한 문장은?
choices: Jenny has called me twice yesterday.
He has lost his wallet, so he can't pay now.
The twins have grown a lot since I saw them last year.
items.exp: yesterday는 명확한 과거 표현이라 현재완료와 쓸 수 없어서 'called'가 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 과거분사 형태가 틀린 문장은?
choices: The baby has slept for ten hours.
My dad has driven this car since 2018.
Have they ever flown in a helicopter?
She hasn't spoke to me since the fight.
items.exp: speak의 과거분사는 spoken이라 'hasn't spoken'이 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어순이 틀린 문장은?
choices: What have you done with my pen?
Has your uncle ever visited Jeju?
Why did she leave the party early?
How long have you known Minho?
Where you have put my glasses?
items.exp: 의문사가 있는 현재완료 의문문은 ‘의문사 + have + 주어 + p.p.’ 순서라 'Where have you put'이 되어야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I have never seen such a big spider.
(b) He has visited his grandmother last weekend.
(c) They haven't eaten lunch yet.
(d) Has she wrote the answer?
(e) We bought this sofa three years ago.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: never와 현재완료 경험이 알맞아요. (b) 틀림: last weekend는 과거 표현이라 visited를 써야 해요. (c) 옳음: yet과 현재완료 부정이 알맞아요. (d) 틀림: write의 과거분사는 written이에요. (e) 옳음: ago는 과거 표현이라 과거시제가 알맞아요. 따라서 옳은 문장은 (a), (c), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) My team has won the game twice.
(b) Lisa didn't have breakfast this morning.
(c) The store have just opened its door.
(d) He has not been busy since last week.
(e) When has the show started?
items.exp: (a) 옳음: twice와 현재완료가 알맞아요. (b) 옳음: 과거시제 부정문이에요. (c) 틀림: 3인칭 단수 주어에는 has를 써야 해요. (d) 옳음: since + 과거 시점과 현재완료 부정이에요. (e) 틀림: 의문사 when은 현재완료와 쓸 수 없어서 When did the show start?로 써요. 따라서 틀린 문장은 (c), (e) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Have you ever ridden a horse?
(b) She has not drank any water today.
(c) The singer was born in 1999 and became famous in 2020.
(d) The rain has stopped, so we can go out.
(e) They have already left for the airport.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: ride의 과거분사 ridden을 바르게 썼어요. (b) 틀림: drink의 과거분사는 drunk예요. (c) 옳음: in + 과거 연도는 과거시제와 함께 써요. (d) 옳음: 현재완료 결과 용법이에요. (e) 옳음: already와 현재완료가 알맞아요. 따라서 옳은 문장은 (a), (c), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I lost my phone last night, but I found it.
(b) He has finished the work an hour ago.
(c) Have you taken a photo with the actor?
(d) She has not came to school since Monday.
(e) The rain stopped when the game began.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: last night은 과거 표현이라 과거시제가 알맞아요. (b) 틀림: ago는 과거 표현이라 finished를 써야 해요. (c) 옳음: 현재완료 의문문이에요. (d) 틀림: come의 과거분사는 come이에요. (e) 옳음: when이 이끄는 과거 시점이라 과거시제가 알맞아요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e)이에요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) My brother has broken his leg, so he is in the hospital.
(b) I have known Sam when I was young.
(c) Have you ever been in a hurry?
(d) The movie hasn't ended yet.
(e) Has your father arrive home yet?
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 현재와 관련된 결과라 현재완료가 알맞아요. (b) 틀림: when I was young은 과거 시점이라 knew를 써야 해요. (c) 옳음: 경험을 묻는 현재완료 의문문이에요. (d) 옳음: yet과 현재완료 부정이에요. (e) 틀림: 현재완료의 p.p.가 필요해서 arrived여야 해요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (e)이에요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) We had a great time at the party yesterday.
(b) Where have you been since this morning?
(c) Her cat has hidden under the bed twice.
(d) He has seen that movie in 2019.
(e) I haven't spoken to her since the fight.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: yesterday는 과거시제와 써요. (b) 옳음: 의문사 + have + 주어 + p.p. 순서예요. (c) 옳음: hide의 과거분사 hidden을 바르게 썼어요. (d) 틀림: in 2019는 과거 연도라 saw를 써야 해요. (e) 옳음: speak의 과거분사 spoken이에요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (e)이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Sora (A) her best friend since 2016, and she (B) her a gift two days ago.
items.exp: since 2016은 현재완료와, two days ago는 과거시제와 함께 써요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Have you ever (A) a whale? — No, but my father (B) one on a trip last year.
items.exp: Have you ever 뒤에는 p.p.(seen)가 오고, last year는 과거 표현이라 saw를 써요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
How long (A) he (B) the guitar? — He (C) it since he was ten.
items.exp: ‘의문사 + has + 주어 + p.p.’이고, since가 있으므로 답에도 현재완료 has played를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 우리는 2010년부터 이 마을에 살고 있다.
items.exp: since 2010은 현재완료와 함께 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 소년은 아직 자기 방을 청소하지 않았다.
items.exp: 현재완료 부정문은 has not + p.p.예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 너는 그 가수를 얼마나 오래 알고 지냈니?
items.exp: 의문사가 있는 현재완료 의문문은 ‘have + 주어 + p.p.’ 순서예요.

items.q: 다음 두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: Mina lost her key, and she still doesn't have it. → Mina ___ her key.
items.exp: 과거에 잃어버려 지금도 없는 상태이므로 현재완료 has lost를 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: I [have visited] my aunt two days ago. → ___
items.exp: two days ago는 과거 표현이라 현재완료를 쓸 수 없어요.

items.q: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: Our cat has ___ under the sofa since noon.
items.exp: hide의 과거분사는 hidden이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: I have lived in this apartment since five years.
My dog has stayed in the garden since morning.
She has taught English for ten years.
Tom has just gone to the library, so he isn't here.
Have you ever seen a rainbow at night?
items.exp: since 뒤에는 시점이 오고 for 뒤에는 기간이 와요. five years는 기간이므로 'for five years'가 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: Mia has been to Paris, so she is still there now.
I have gone to the museum three times.
We haven't seen him for last month.
He has already eaten dinner, so he isn't hungry.
items.exp: already는 긍정문에 쓰는 완료 표현이에요. 나머지는 has gone to(지금 여기 없음), have been to(경험), since last month, hasn't left yet으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 현재완료의 쓰임이 틀린 문장은?
choices: How long have you lived in Ulsan?
My grandfather has never ridden a bike.
She has lost her ring, so she is looking for it.
The singer has gone to Canada, but she is back now.
It has rained for three days.
items.exp: has gone to는 '~로 가 버렸다(지금 여기 없음)'라는 뜻이라 'she is back now'와 모순이에요. has been to가 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 yet, already의 쓰임이 틀린 문장은?
choices: Have you ever been to a zoo at night?
The movie has not ended already.
He has already finished his lunch.
items.exp: 부정문에서 '아직'은 yet을 써요. already는 긍정문에서 '이미'의 뜻으로 써요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) She has been to Hawaii twice.
(b) He has gone to Busan, so he will be back tomorrow.
(c) I have known Jenny for last year.
(d) Have you ever eaten snails?
(e) We haven't met since a month.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: twice는 경험을 나타내는 표현이라 has been to가 알맞아요. (b) 옳음: has gone to는 지금 여기 없다는 결과의 뜻이라 알맞아요. (c) 틀림: for 뒤에는 기간이 와서 for a year 또는 since last year여야 해요. (d) 옳음: ever를 쓴 경험 의문문이에요. (e) 틀림: since 뒤에는 시점이 와서 for a month 또는 since last month여야 해요. 따라서 옳은 문장은 (a), (b), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) The boys have played soccer since two o'clock.
(b) Has the sale begun yet?
(c) I have just heard the news from my aunt.
(d) My cousin has been to Japan, and he is still there.
(e) She have never drunk coffee.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: since + 시점이에요. (b) 옳음: 의문문의 yet과 begin의 과거분사 begun이 알맞아요. (c) 옳음: just와 현재완료가 알맞아요. (d) 틀림: has been to는 갔다 왔다는 뜻이라 still there와 모순이에요. has gone to가 되어야 해요. (e) 틀림: 3인칭 단수 주어이므로 has를 써야 해요. 따라서 틀린 문장은 (d), (e) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Have you ever lost your wallet on a trip?
(b) My parents have been married for twenty years.
(c) The shop has already closed, so we can't buy bread.
(d) I have gone to Jeju twice, and I loved it.
(e) She has been angry at me since yesterday.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 경험을 묻는 현재완료 의문문이에요. (b) 옳음: for + 기간의 계속 용법이에요. (c) 옳음: 완료·결과 용법이에요. (d) 틀림: 경험을 말할 때는 has been to를 써서 have been to Jeju예요. (e) 옳음: since + 시점의 계속 용법이에요. 따라서 옳은 문장은 (a), (b), (c), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Has he ever been abroad?
(b) The children have been asleep for two hours.
(c) My mom has been to the bank, so she is still there.
(d) She has lived here since ten years.
(e) We have already sold all the tickets.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: ever를 쓴 경험 의문문이에요. (b) 옳음: for + 기간의 계속 용법이에요. (c) 틀림: has been to는 갔다 왔다는 뜻이라 still there와 모순이에요. has gone to가 되어야 해요. (d) 틀림: ten years는 기간이므로 for를 써야 해요. (e) 옳음: already와 현재완료가 알맞아요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (e)이에요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Tom has been to the airport, so he isn't here.
(b) Have you read this novel before?
(c) My brother has lost his bag, so he is upset.
(d) It has snowed since last night.
(e) I haven't heard from her since two weeks.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 여기 없다는 뜻이면 has gone to를 써야 해요. (b) 옳음: before는 경험 용법과 쓰여요. (c) 옳음: 결과 용법이에요. (d) 옳음: since + 시점의 계속 용법이에요. (e) 틀림: two weeks는 기간이므로 for를 써야 해요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (a), (e)이에요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Sue has never flown in a plane.
(b) They have waited for the bus for thirty minutes.
(c) He has gone to the dentist, so he can't answer the phone.
(d) Have you finished the test yet?
(e) I have been to Rome, so I am still in Rome.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: never와 flown이 알맞아요. (b) 옳음: for + 기간의 계속 용법이에요. (c) 옳음: has gone to는 지금 없다는 결과의 뜻이에요. (d) 옳음: 의문문의 yet이 알맞아요. (e) 틀림: have been to는 갔다 왔다는 뜻이라 still in Rome과 모순이에요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (d)이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Eric has (A) to the airport, so he isn't here. Mary has (B) to the airport twice, so she knows the way.
items.exp: 지금 여기 없다는 결과는 gone to, 갔다 왔다는 경험은 been to를 써요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
We have known him (A) ten years, but he has been sick (B) last Monday.
items.exp: ten years는 기간이라 for, last Monday는 시점이라 since를 써요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> I have [already finished] my homework.
choices: She has [lived] in Daegu for ten years.
items.exp: <보기>는 현재완료의 완료 용법이에요. 정답도 just와 함께 쓴 완료 용법이고, 나머지는 경험, 계속, 결과, 경험이에요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 <보기>와 다른 것은?
<보기> They have [been] friends since 2015.
choices: She has [been] sick for three days.
I have [known] him since I was ten.
My father has [worked] at the bank for 20 years.
items.exp: <보기>는 계속 용법이에요. 정답은 ever를 쓴 경험 용법이고, 나머지는 for와 since를 쓴 계속 용법이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 그 영화를 세 번 본 적이 있다.
items.exp: 횟수를 나타내는 three times는 경험 용법이라 have seen을 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Anna는 지난달부터 줄곧 발레를 배우고 있다.
items.exp: since last month는 계속 용법이라 has + p.p.를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그는 런던에 가 버려서 지금 여기에 없다.
items.s: He ___ London, so he is not here now.
items.exp: 지금 여기 없다는 결과의 뜻이므로 has gone to를 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: I have worked on this project [since] three months. → ___
items.exp: three months는 기간이므로 for를 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: She has [gone] to Egypt twice, so she knows a lot. → ___
items.exp: 경험을 나타내므로 have been to를 써요.

items.q: 다음 두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: Nora started to play the cello five years ago, and she still plays it. → Nora ___ the cello for five years.
items.exp: 과거에 시작해 지금까지 계속되므로 현재완료 has played를 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: My little brother can swim, but he can't dive.
She said that she would help me after lunch.
Will you open the window, please?
The baby may be hungry because she is crying.
We will can see the stars from the top of the hill.
items.exp: 조동사는 두 개를 연달아 쓸 수 없어요. will can 대신 will be able to를 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: I am sure you will be able to speak English well soon.
He didn't can finish his homework last night.
May I borrowing your dictionary for a moment?
My brother said he will visit us the next day.
Does she can play the violin?
items.exp: will be able to는 can의 미래 표현이에요. 나머지는 couldn't finish, borrow, would visit, Can she로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 조동사 뒤 동사의 형태가 틀린 문장은?
choices: You may use my computer if you finish your work.
He said that his daughter might likes the gift.
They might be late because of the traffic.
Could you pass me the salt, please?
I wasn't able to sleep well last night.
items.exp: 조동사 might 뒤에는 동사원형이 와서 might like가 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 be able to의 쓰임이 틀린 문장은?
choices: Our team will be able to win the game.
Jenny is able to speak three languages.
I was able to find the answer in the end.
Birds are able fly because they have wings.
Can I use your pen? — Sure, you can.
items.exp: be able to 뒤에는 to부정사가 필요해서 'are able to fly'가 되어야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Can you help me with this box?
(b) He will can come to the party tomorrow.
(c) My sister might be asleep now.
(d) Will I sit here?
(e) You may not enter the room without a ticket.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: can은 요청을 나타내요. (b) 틀림: 조동사를 연달아 쓸 수 없어서 will be able to를 써야 해요. (c) 옳음: might + 동사원형으로 추측을 나타내요. (d) 틀림: 허락을 구할 때는 May I나 Can I를 써요. (e) 옳음: may not은 금지를 나타내요. 따라서 옳은 문장은 (a), (c), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Would you turn down the music?
(b) The boy could solve the puzzle easily last week.
(c) Mr. Lee may goes to the meeting.
(d) They will be able to buy a new house next year.
(e) I'm sorry, but I don't can answer that question.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: would you는 정중한 요청이에요. (b) 옳음: could는 can의 과거예요. (c) 틀림: 조동사 may 뒤에는 동사원형 go를 써요. (d) 옳음: will be able to는 can의 미래 표현이에요. (e) 틀림: 조동사 can에는 don't를 쓰지 않아서 I can't answer예요. 따라서 틀린 문장은 (c), (e) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) May I ask you a question?
(b) She will help us tomorrow.
(c) Tom isn't here. He might be at the library.
(d) My grandma said that she would visit us soon.
(e) You can to take a break now.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: May I ~?는 허락을 구하는 표현이에요. (b) 옳음: will + 동사원형이에요. (c) 옳음: might는 불확실한 추측이에요. (d) 옳음: 과거에 한 말이므로 will의 과거형 would를 써요. (e) 틀림: 조동사 뒤에는 to 없이 동사원형을 써서 can take예요. 따라서 옳은 문장은 (a), (b), (c), (d) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Can I use your phone for a minute?
(b) He will be able to drive next month.
(c) They mights come to our party.
(d) I could not to open the door.
(e) She said she would call me back.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: can은 허락을 구하는 표현이에요. (b) 옳음: will be able to는 can의 미래예요. (c) 틀림: 조동사는 주어에 따라 형태가 변하지 않고 might 뒤에는 동사원형이 와요. (d) 틀림: 조동사 could 뒤에는 to 없이 동사원형 open을 써요. (e) 옳음: will의 과거형 would를 바르게 썼어요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (e)이에요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Would you please speak more slowly?
(b) We will be able to see the festival tomorrow.
(c) You may leaves the room now.
(d) The girl is able to plays the piano.
(e) The ice may be thin, so be careful.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: would you는 정중한 요청이에요. (b) 옳음: will be able to는 미래의 가능을 나타내요. (c) 틀림: may 뒤에는 동사원형 leave를 써요. (d) 틀림: be able to 뒤에는 동사원형 play를 써요. (e) 옳음: may는 불확실한 추측이에요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (d)이에요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The sun will rise at six tomorrow.
(b) Could you bring me a glass of water?
(c) My cousin was able to ski when he was five.
(d) The rumor may true.
(e) Will you be able to join us on Friday?
items.exp: (a) 옳음: will은 미래의 일을 나타내요. (b) 옳음: could you는 정중한 요청이에요. (c) 옳음: was able to는 can의 과거 표현이에요. (d) 틀림: may 뒤에는 동사원형 be가 필요해서 may be true예요. (e) 옳음: will과 be able to를 함께 쓴 올바른 의문문이에요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (e)이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
My uncle (A) speak French when he was young, and he (B) be able to teach us next week.
items.exp: when he was young이므로 과거의 능력 could, next week이므로 미래의 will be able to를 써요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
The sky is cloudy, but I am not sure. It (A) rain this afternoon. I (B) take my umbrella, I promise.
items.exp: 확신이 없는 추측은 may, 약속하는 의지는 will을 써요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 Could의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> [Could] you lend me a pen?
choices: I [could] run fast when I was young.
My dad [could] swim when he was six.
They [could] not find the keys yesterday.
The boy [could] read at the age of three.
items.exp: <보기>는 '~해 주시겠어요?'라는 요청이에요. 정답도 요청이고, 나머지는 모두 과거의 능력을 나타내요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 may의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> He [may] be sick today.
items.exp: <보기>는 불확실한 추측('~일지도 모른다')이에요. 정답도 추측이고, 나머지는 허락을 나타내요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그녀는 어릴 때 피아노를 칠 수 있었다.
items.s: She ___ the piano when she was young.
items.exp: 과거의 능력은 could를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 우리는 내일 그 전시회를 볼 수 있을 것이다.
items.exp: can의 미래 표현은 will be able to예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그는 아파서 오늘 학교에 못 올지도 몰라.
items.s: He ___ come to school today because he is sick.
items.exp: 불확실한 부정 추측은 may not이나 might not으로 나타내요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: She will [can] finish the work by noon. → ___
items.exp: 조동사를 연달아 쓸 수 없어서 can 대신 be able to를 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.exp: 허락을 구할 때는 May I, Can I, Could I를 써요.

items.q: 다음 두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.s: Are you going to join the club? → ___ you join the club?
items.exp: be going to는 will로 바꿔 쓸 수 있어요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: You must not park your bike in front of the gate.
Tom didn't have to bring his lunch because the school served meals.
She has to wear a uniform at her job.
The boy who won three prizes must to be very proud.
You shouldn't skip breakfast every day.
items.exp: 'must to be'는 틀려요. 조동사 must 뒤에는 to 없이 동사원형이 와서 must be가 맞아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: My sister don't have to wash the dishes tonight.
Do we have to finish the project by Friday?
You not should eat so much candy.
He musts leave early to catch the train.
They had to walked home last night.
items.exp: 'Do we have to finish ~?'만 맞아요. 나머지는 doesn't have to, should not, must leave(조동사는 -s 없음), had to walk이어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
choices: You will have to wait for about ten minutes.
It must be cold outside because everyone is wearing coats.
Do I have to bring my own pencil case?
Kids under ten must not enter the pool alone.
Did Mina had to take care of her brother yesterday?
items.exp: 'Did Mina had to ~?'는 did 뒤에 동사원형이 와야 해서 Did Mina have to ~?가 맞아요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 올바르지 않은 것은?
choices: My parents has to work on Saturdays this month.
The boy standing by the windows must be Jisu's younger brother.
The children in the back row should be quiet during the concert.
Nobody has to know about the surprise party.
You shouldn't open the oven while the cake is baking.
items.exp: 'My parents has to'는 주어가 복수이므로 have to가 맞아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
choices: She doesn't has to pay for the ticket.
You should to see a doctor about that cough.
The twins have to share a room until next year.
We must not to forget the password.
Does she has to leave now?
items.exp: 'The twins have to share ~'만 맞아요. 나머지는 doesn't have to, should see, must not forget, Does she have to ~?가 맞아요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I don't have to buy a new bag because mine is still good.
(b) The twins has to clean the yard after school.
(c) You should not leave your valuables in the car.
(d) Did you had to wake up early on Sunday?
(e) Everyone must wear a helmet on this track.

items.ctx: 그 편지는 어제 Sam에 의해 쓰여졌다.
items.exp: 편지는 '쓰여진' 것이고 yesterday이므로 was written이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 저녁 식사는 지금 아빠에 의해 준비되고 있다.
items.exp: 지금 진행 중인 수동은 is being + 과거분사예요.

items.q:
다음 문장을 수동태로 바꿔 쓰세요.
My uncle will build a small house here.
items.s: A small house ___ by my uncle here.
items.exp: 미래 수동태는 will be + 과거분사예요.

items.q:
다음 문장을 수동태로 바꿔 쓰세요.
The students are cleaning the classroom now.
items.s: The classroom ___ by the students now.
items.exp: 현재진행형의 수동태는 is being + 과거분사예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: These pictures [was] taken by my aunt last summer. → ___
a: These pictures were taken by my aunt last summer
items.exp: 주어 These pictures가 복수라서 were taken이에요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The accident [was happened] near the school last night. → ___
a: The accident happened near the school last night
items.exp: happen은 자동사라서 수동태로 쓸 수 없어요.

units.name: Ch4-2 수동태의 여러 형태 · 동사구 · by 이외의 전치사

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: The window can't be opened from outside.
How was the cake made by you?
When was the old castle build?
The rules must be followed by everyone.
Was the thief caught by the police?
items.exp: 'When was the old castle build?'는 수동태 의문문이므로 과거분사 built를 써서 When was the old castle built?가 돼요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
choices: The shelf is filled with old books.
We were surprised for the loud noise.
Her hair was covered of dust.
He is interested at ancient history.
I'm worried of my test result.
items.exp: 'The shelf is filled with ~'만 맞아요. 나머지는 be surprised at, be covered with, be interested in, be worried about으로 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법에 맞지 않는 것은?
choices: The baby was taken care of by her aunt.
The meeting was put off because of the rain.
The kitten was looked after by the girl.
The old man was laughed by the kids.
The lights were turned off by the guard.
items.exp: laugh at은 동사구이므로 수동태에서도 at이 필요해요. 'was laughed by'가 아니라 was laughed at by가 맞아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
choices: The old boxes were made use by us.
The puppy was brought up by an old lady.
The dog was ran over by a car.
The radio was turned on it by Mom.
Her plan was carried by the team out.
items.exp: 'The puppy was brought up ~'만 맞아요. 나머지는 made use of, run over의 과거분사 run, 불필요한 목적어 it, 떼어 쓸 수 없는 carry out 때문에 틀려요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
choices: The ticket will be sent to you by e-mail.
Is the room being cleaned now?
The project should be finished by Friday.
The cookies are not sold in this shop.
The song didn't sung by the boys at the concert.
items.exp: 'The song didn't sung'은 틀려요. 수동태 부정문은 be동사 + not + 과거분사라서 The song wasn't sung ~이 맞아요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The door can be opened with this key.
(b) Was the bike steal yesterday?
(c) The old coat was covered with dust.
(d) Mina is satisfied about her new room.
(e) The bridge will be built by a Korean company.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: Was the bike stolen. (c) 옳음. (d) 틀림: be satisfied with. (e) 옳음. 따라서 (a), (c), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) The package must sent today.
(b) Were the flowers watered by Jim?
(c) The baby was taken care by her sister.
(d) The singer is known for all teenagers.
(e) Did the window broken by the boy?
items.exp: (a) 틀림: must be sent. (b) 옳음. (c) 틀림: was taken care of. (d) 틀림: 사람들에게 알려져 있다는 be known to. (e) 틀림: Was the window broken by the boy?. 따라서 틀린 것은 (a), (c), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은 모두 몇 개인가?
(a) Cheese is made for milk.
(b) The soup was not be eaten by anyone.
(c) Our teacher is known to her kindness.
(d) The famous actor is known to many people in Asia.
(e) The box was filled of toys.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: made from(of). (b) 틀림: was not eaten. (c) 틀림: be known for(~로 유명하다). (d) 옳음. (e) 틀림: be filled with. 따라서 (d) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Flowers should not be picked in this park.
(b) The rule was be changed last year.
(c) Are your shoes made of leather?
(d) The pupils were laughed at by their classmates.
(e) He was surprised with the news.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: was changed. (c) 옳음. (d) 옳음. (e) 틀림: be surprised at. 따라서 (a), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The old sofa was thrown away by us.
(b) She was pleased of the birthday card.
(c) Was the machine turn off by Tom?
(d) The food will be delivered within an hour.
(e) English is not speak in this village.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: be pleased with. (c) 틀림: turned off. (d) 옳음. (e) 틀림: is not spoken. 따라서 (b), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The mission was carried out by the team.
(b) Were these chairs made by wood?
(c) The test is being graded by Ms. Han.
(d) The lights must turn off by the last student.
(e) Everyone was worried about the storm.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: 재료는 of로 made of wood. (c) 옳음. (d) 틀림: must be turned off. (e) 옳음. 따라서 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
The bag (A) leather, and it (B) many tourists.
choices: is made of – is known to
is made for – is known to
is made of – is known for
is made by – is known for
is made in – is known as
items.exp: 재료는 be made of이고 '~에게 알려져 있다'는 be known to예요.

items.q:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
The concert (A) because of the typhoon. The fans (B) the news.
choices: was put off – were surprised for
was put off – were surprised at
items.exp: 동사구 put off는 수동태에서도 off를 붙이고, '~에 놀라다'는 be surprised at이에요.

items.q:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
A: Where (A) this photo (B)?
B: It was taken by my aunt in Jeju.
items.exp: 사진은 '찍힌' 것이고 주어가 단수이므로 Where was this photo taken?이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 에어컨은 지금 수리되고 있지 않다.
items.exp: 현재진행 수동태의 부정은 is not being + 과거분사예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 아이들은 보모에게 돌봄을 받았다.
items.exp: 동사구 take care of를 수동태로 쓸 때 of까지 붙여요.

items.q:
다음 문장을 수동태 의문문으로 바꿔 쓰세요.
Did Mr. Kim write this letter?
items.exp: 과거 수동태 의문문은 Was + 주어 + 과거분사 ~?예요.

items.q:
다음 문장을 수동태로 바꿔 쓰세요.
You must not open this door.
items.exp: 조동사 수동태는 조동사 + be + 과거분사이고 부정은 must not be opened예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: Mina was satisfied [of] her test result. → ___
a: Mina was satisfied with her test result
items.exp: '~에 만족하다'는 be satisfied with예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The baby was [looked by] her aunt. → ___
a: The baby was looked after by her aunt
The baby was taken care of by her aunt
items.exp: 동사구 look after는 수동태에서 after를 남겨 was looked after by가 돼요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: It is difficult to learn three languages at once.
That is dangerous to swim in this river.
My brother promised not to tell my secret.
We don't know where to hold the party.
Her wish is to visit Italy someday.
items.exp: 'That is dangerous to swim ~'은 가주어 자리에 That이 아니라 It을 써야 해서 It is dangerous to swim ~이 맞아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
choices: She knows what to say at the meeting.
He decided don't to join the club.
I promised don't be late again.
My dream is be a vet.
items.exp: 'She knows what to say ~'만 맞아요. 나머지는 decided not to join, wanted to play, promised not to be, is to be가 맞아요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법에 맞지 않는 것은?
choices: Jenny learned how to ride a bicycle.
He told me what to do next.
I'm not sure when to I should call him.
Please tell me which bus to take.
She asked me how I should fix it.
items.exp: 'when to I should call'은 의문사 + to부정사와 의문사 + 주어 + should를 섞은 거라 틀려요. when to call him 또는 when I should call him이 맞아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
choices: It is hard keep a diary every day.
To tell a lie is wrong.
To doing homework on time is a good habit.
Mina hopes to be not nervous on stage.
He enjoys to read comic books.
items.exp: 'To tell a lie is wrong.'만 맞아요. 나머지는 to keep, To do, not to be nervous, enjoys reading이 맞아요(enjoy는 동명사를 목적어로 취해요).

items.q:
밑줄 친 to부정사의 용법이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> I hope [to see] you again soon.
choices: I have a lot of homework [to do].
She grew up [to be] a doctor.
He was glad [to meet] his old friend.
My plan is [to travel] around Jeju.
She saved money [to buy] a camera.
items.exp: <보기>는 hope의 목적어인 명사적 용법이에요. 보어로 쓰인 'is to travel'이 같은 명사적 용법이고, 나머지는 homework to do(형용사적), 결과·감정의 원인·목적(부사적) 용법이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 밑줄 친 to부정사의 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: It is fun [to play] chess with my uncle.
Her job is [to teach] math to children.
I don't know how [to use] this machine.
She went to the library [to return] the books.
items.exp: 'to return the books'는 '~하기 위해'의 부사적 용법이고, 나머지는 진주어·보어·목적어로 쓰인 명사적 용법이에요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) My goal is to finish the marathon.
(b) They agreed to meeting at noon.
(c) She learned how to bake bread from her aunt.
(d) It is exciting meet new people.
(e) I wonder where to put these boxes.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: agreed to meet. (c) 옳음. (d) 틀림: It is exciting to meet. (e) 옳음. 따라서 (a), (c), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) She hopes meeting him soon.
(b) We planned to take a trip next month.
(c) I don't know what do next.
(d) His hobby is to collect old coins.
(e) She chose not to go there alone.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: hopes to meet. (b) 옳음. (c) 틀림: what to do next. (d) 옳음. (e) 옳음: not to + 동사원형. 따라서 틀린 것은 (a), (c) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은 모두 몇 개인가?
(a) I have decided to study abroad.
(b) It isn't easy to make friends in a new school.
(c) Mom told me when go to bed.
(d) My uncle taught us how to fish.
(e) To wake up early makes me tired.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음. (c) 틀림: when to go. (d) 옳음. (e) 옳음: to부정사 주어는 단수 취급해 makes. 따라서 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Do you know where to buy tickets?
(b) The boy learned swim last summer.
(c) It is a good idea to take a short break.
(d) Her dream is to becoming a singer.
(e) He decided not to buy the expensive bag.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: learned to swim. (c) 옳음. (d) 틀림: to become. (e) 옳음. 따라서 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Is it safe to cross the road here?
(b) Don't forget close the door.
(c) We need to know how to solve the problem.
(d) To eat vegetables are good for your health.
(e) The teacher told us what we should to do.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: forget to close. (c) 옳음. (d) 틀림: to부정사 주어는 단수라 is. (e) 틀림: what we should do 또는 what to do. 따라서 (b), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) It is not easy keep promises.
(b) My job is to teach kids.
(c) They don't know which road to take.
(d) I want that you come early.
(e) To lose weight takes time.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: to keep. (b) 옳음. (c) 옳음. (d) 틀림: want you to come. (e) 옳음. 따라서 (b), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Can you tell me (A) to get to the station? I promised my parents (B) to be late again.
items.exp: '어떻게 ~할지'는 how to, to부정사의 부정은 not to예요.

items.q:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) is hard to follow a diet. My sister showed me (B) to cook rice.
items.exp: 가주어는 It이고, cook rice에 목적어가 이미 있으므로 what이 아닌 how to cook이 돼요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 그에게 언제 전화해야 할지 모르겠다.
items.exp: '언제 ~할지'는 when + to부정사예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 내 꿈은 세계 여행을 하는 것이다.
items.s: My dream is ___ around the world.
items.exp: 보어 자리의 to부정사는 '~하는 것'을 뜻해요.

items.q:
두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
To make a promise is easy.
items.exp: to부정사 주어는 가주어 It으로 바꾸고 to부정사는 뒤로 보내요.

items.q:
다음 문장을 같은 뜻의 의문사 + to부정사로 바꿔 쓰세요.
She didn't know what she should wear.
items.exp: 의문사 + 주어 + should + 동사원형은 의문사 + to부정사로 바꿀 수 있어요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: She decided [don't go] to the party. → ___
a: She decided not to go to the party
items.exp: to부정사의 부정은 to 앞에 not을 써요. 따라서 not to go예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그는 다시는 거짓말을 하지 않겠다고 약속했다.
items.exp: promise는 to부정사를 목적어로 취하고 부정은 not(또는 never) to예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: She bought a house to live.
I need a pen to write with.
He has nothing special to say.
We found a quiet place to study in.
Do you have anything cold to drink?
items.exp: 'a house to live'는 live in a house의 관계라 전치사 in이 필요해서 a house to live in이 맞아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
choices: She needs a friend to talk.
He wants something to eat delicious.
He has special nothing to do.
We have much work to do today.
I found a box to put the books.
items.exp: 'We have much work to do today.'만 맞아요. 나머지는 friend to talk with, something delicious to eat, nothing special, a box to put the books in으로 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법에 맞지 않는 것은?
choices: I need a pencil to write.
There is nothing interesting to watch tonight.
She is looking for a room to stay in.
He doesn't have any money to buy lunch.
They have a lot of problems to solve.
items.exp: 'a pencil to write'는 write with a pencil의 관계라 전치사가 필요해서 a pencil to write with가 맞아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
choices: The meeting is to hold at noon.
You are to be quiet in the library.
If you are to win the race, you must practiced hard.
The train is to arrives at nine.
No stars were to seen in the sky.
items.exp: 'You are to be quiet ~'만 맞아요. be to 용법 뒤에는 동사원형이 와요. 나머지는 to be held, must practice, to arrive, to be seen이어야 해요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 to부정사의 용법이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> She has a lot of homework [to do].
choices: I went to the store [to buy] some milk.
He is glad [to see] his teacher.
We need a room [to meet in].
items.exp: <보기>는 homework를 꾸미는 형용사적 용법이에요. 'a room to meet in'도 room을 꾸미는 형용사적 용법이고, 나머지는 부사적 또는 명사적 용법이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 밑줄 친 to부정사의 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: He has a house [to live in].
There is nothing [to eat] in the kitchen.
She needs a chair [to sit on].
He grew up [to be] a pianist.
items.exp: 'grew up to be'는 결과를 나타내는 부사적 용법이고, 나머지는 앞의 명사·대명사를 꾸미는 형용사적 용법이에요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I need a spoon to eat soup with.
(b) She has no friend to play.
(c) Is there anything hot to drink?
(d) I bought something to wear special.
(e) They have a big yard to play in.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: friend to play with. (c) 옳음. (d) 틀림: something special to wear. (e) 옳음. 따라서 (a), (c), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) There are many places visit in Seoul.
(b) The soldier was never to return home.
(c) The party is to starts at six.
(d) She has two letters to send.
(e) He found a cave to hide in.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: places to visit. (b) 옳음: 운명을 나타내는 be to. (c) 틀림: is to start. (d) 옳음. (e) 옳음. 따라서 틀린 것은 (a), (c) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은 모두 몇 개인가?

(b) The students are to wear uniforms on Monday.
(c) I have nothing important to tell you.
(d) He needs a person to rely.
(e) It's time to go to bed.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음: 의무를 나타내는 be to. (c) 옳음. (d) 틀림: a person to rely on. (e) 옳음. 따라서 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I need a bag to carry my books in.
(b) She wants something warm wear.
(c) He has nobody to help him.
(d) We found a lake to swim.
(e) Give me something sweet to eat.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: something warm to wear. (c) 옳음. (d) 틀림: a lake to swim in. (e) 옳음. 따라서 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) My uncle has a bench to rest on.
(b) We have much work do today.
(c) There is nothing to be afraid.
(d) The test is to taking next week.
(e) He has a lot of friends to talk with.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: work to do. (c) 틀림: nothing to be afraid of. (d) 틀림: is to take. (e) 옳음. 따라서 (b), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) No one was to be seen on the street.
(b) Mina has an interesting something to share.
(c) The new bridge is to open in May.
(d) She has a plan visit Jeju next month.
(e) Do you have a pen to write with?
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: something interesting to share. (c) 옳음: 예정을 나타내는 be to. (d) 틀림: a plan to visit. (e) 옳음. 따라서 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
I need a pen to write (A). I want something (B) to drink.
items.exp: write with a pen의 관계라 전치사 with가 필요하고, -thing 뒤에서 꾸미는 말은 부사가 아닌 형용사 cold예요.

items.q:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
If you (A) to pass the exam, you should study hard. Long ago, the soldiers (B) never to see their homes again.
items.exp: be to 용법에서 be동사는 주어와 시제에 맞춰요. you는 are, 복수 soldiers는 과거 were예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 오늘 읽을 책이 세 권 있다.
items.exp: 명사 books 뒤에서 to부정사가 꾸며요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그녀는 같이 이야기할 친구가 필요하다.
items.exp: talk with a friend의 관계라 전치사를 남겨요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 냉장고에 마실 차가운 것이 있니?
items.exp: -thing으로 끝나는 말은 형용사가 뒤에서 꾸미고 그 뒤에 to부정사가 와요.

items.q:
다음 두 문장을 하나로 합쳐 to부정사 구문으로 쓰세요.
I want a chair. I will sit on it.
items.exp: sit on a chair의 관계라 전치사 on이 필요해요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
a: He has nothing special to say
items.exp: -thing 형 대명사는 형용사가 뒤에서 꾸며서 nothing special이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 영화는 곧 시작될 예정이다.
items.exp: 예정을 나타내는 be to 용법이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: He was glad to pass the test.
She was disappointed to hear the result.
I was happily to see my cousin again.
The question is hard to answer.
My father works hard to support our family.
items.exp: 'was happily to see'는 틀려요. 감정의 원인을 나타내는 to부정사 앞에는 부사가 아닌 감정 형용사 happy가 와야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
choices: The box is easy to carry it.
She ran fast catch the bus.
This puzzle is difficultly to solve.
She must be brave jump from the cliff.
The girl must be brave to speak in front of everyone.
items.exp: 'The girl must be brave to speak ~'만 맞아요. easy to carry(목적어 it 중복 불가), ran fast to catch, difficult to solve, brave to jump가 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법에 맞지 않는 것은?
choices: We were shocked to see the broken window.
She grew up becoming a famous chef.
He lived to be ninety years old.
I woke up to find my room full of snow.
They studied hard to get good grades.
items.exp: 'grew up becoming'은 틀려요. 결과를 나타낼 때는 grow up + to부정사로 써서 grew up to be가 맞아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
choices: The lake is dangerous swim in.
I'm so excited to going on a trip.
He hurried to arriving on time.
The story is interesting to read.
She was pleased receive the prize.
items.exp: 'The story is interesting to read.'만 맞아요. 나머지는 dangerous to swim in, excited to go, hurried to arrive, pleased to receive처럼 to부정사를 써야 해요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 to부정사의 용법이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> She was surprised [to hear] the news.
choices: He studied hard [to pass] the exam.
She must be tired [to sleep] so long.
I was sad [to leave] my old school.
He woke up [to find] the window broken.
items.exp: <보기>는 감정의 원인이에요. 'sad to leave'가 같은 용법이고, 나머지는 목적, 판단의 근거, 형용사 수식, 결과 용법이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 밑줄 친 to부정사의 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: She saved money [to buy] a bike.
I was happy [to see] my old friend.
I called him [to ask] about the schedule.
He went to the park [to take] pictures.
We got up early [to see] the sunrise.
items.exp: 'happy to see'는 감정의 원인이고, 나머지는 모두 '~하기 위해'의 목적이에요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Jisu went to the mall to buy a gift.
(b) I'm sorry to hearing the bad news.
(c) This game is easy to play.
(d) The girl grew up be a nurse.
(e) You must be kind to share your lunch.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 목적. (b) 틀림: sorry to hear. (c) 옳음: 형용사 수식. (d) 틀림: grew up to be. (e) 옳음: 판단의 근거. 따라서 (a), (c), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) The mountain is difficult to climb it.
(b) She was happy see her friends.
(c) He woke up to find himself on the sofa.
(d) I turned on the radio for listen to music.
(e) The boy lived to being eighty.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 주어 The mountain이 climb의 목적어라 it을 쓰지 않아요. (b) 틀림: happy to see. (c) 옳음: 결과. (d) 틀림: to listen. (e) 틀림: lived to be. 따라서 틀린 것은 (a), (b), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은 모두 몇 개인가?
(a) She was pleased to get your letter.
(b) This coat is comfortably to wear.
(c) He saved money to bought a tablet.
(d) I'm very glad to met you.
(e) Mina studied hard to become a doctor.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: comfortable to wear. (c) 틀림: to buy. (d) 틀림: to meet. (e) 옳음. 따라서 (a), (e) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The boy was excited to ride the roller coaster.
(b) The cake is deliciously to eat.
(c) He must be foolish to believe such a lie.
(d) She practiced hard win the contest.
(e) He grew up to be a great leader.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: delicious. (c) 옳음. (d) 틀림: to win. (e) 옳음. 따라서 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I felt sadly to leave my hometown.
(b) My grandmother lived to be a hundred.
(c) The problem is hard to solve it.
(d) We were disappointed to lose the game.
(e) She works out every day staying healthy.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: sad. (b) 옳음. (c) 틀림: it을 쓰지 않아요. (d) 옳음. (e) 틀림: to stay healthy. 따라서 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Tom was surprised hear the loud sound.
(b) She went abroad to study music.
(c) He studied hard only to fail the test.
(d) This river is dangerous to swimming in.
(e) You must be strong to lift that box.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: to hear. (b) 옳음. (c) 옳음: only to는 결과. (d) 틀림: to swim in. (e) 옳음. 따라서 (b), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
I called her (A) about the homework. I was (B) to hear her voice.
items.exp: 목적은 to부정사 to ask, 감정의 원인 앞에는 형용사 glad가 와요.

items.q:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
The rule is (A) to understand. She grew up (B) a scientist.
items.exp: to부정사가 형용사를 수식하므로 (A)는 형용사 easy이고, 결과는 grew up + to be예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그는 막차를 타기 위해 뛰었다.
items.exp: 목적을 나타내는 to부정사예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 소식을 듣고 나는 매우 놀랐다.
items.exp: 감정 형용사 뒤의 to부정사는 감정의 원인을 나타내요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그녀는 자라서 유명한 화가가 되었다.
items.exp: 결과를 나타내는 grow up + to부정사예요.

items.q:
다음 두 문장을 to부정사를 이용해 한 문장으로 쓰세요.
She is happy. She met her old teacher.
items.s: She is happy ___ her old teacher.
items.exp: 감정 형용사 뒤에서 감정의 원인을 to부정사로 나타내요. 따라서 to meet이에요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
a: This puzzle is easy to solve
items.exp: to부정사가 형용사를 수식하는 구조라서 be동사 뒤에는 형용사 easy가 와요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The man must be honest [return] the wallet. → ___
a: The man must be honest to return the wallet
items.exp: 판단의 근거를 나타내는 부사적 용법이라 to부정사 to return이에요.

units.name: Ch5-4 의미상 주어 · to부정사를 이용한 구문

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: It was cruel of the boys to laugh at the old man.
It is not easy for my grandmother to use a smartphone.
The question was too hard for the students to answer it.
The river was shallow enough for us to cross on foot.
It was polite of her to hold the door for strangers.
items.exp: too hard for the students to answer에서 answer의 목적어는 주어 The question이에요. 그래서 목적어 it을 또 쓰면 안 되고 answer만 써야 해요. 나머지는 cruel/polite는 of, easy는 for를 바르게 썼어요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: It was foolish him to trust a stranger.
She is enough tall to reach the top shelf.
The soup was too hot for me eat.
It was rude of he to interrupt the teacher.
It is necessary for children to get enough sleep.
items.exp: necessary는 성품형용사가 아니라서 for children이 맞아요. foolish는 of him, enough는 tall 뒤(tall enough), too hot for me to eat, of 뒤에는 목적격 him이 와야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 문장은?
choices: She spoke enough clearly for the whole class to understand.
The movie was too boring for us to watch until the end.
It was brave of the little girl to speak in front of everyone.
It is dangerous for children to play near the road.
He ran fast enough to catch the last train.
items.exp: enough가 형용사나 부사를 꾸밀 때는 그 뒤에 와요. clearly enough로 고쳐야 해요. 나머지 문장은 too ~ to, of(brave), for(dangerous), 형용사/부사 + enough to가 모두 맞아요.

items.q: 다음 중 두 문장의 의미가 서로 같지 않은 것은?
choices: The room was too dark for him to read. = The room was so dark that he couldn't read.
She is smart enough to solve the puzzle. = She is so smart that she can solve the puzzle.
The lake was warm enough for us to swim in. = The lake was so warm that we could swim in it.
Jim was too tired to walk home. = Jim was so tired that he can't walk home.
The question was too difficult for me to answer. = The question was so difficult that I couldn't answer it.
items.exp: so ~ that 문장은 앞 문장과 시제를 맞춰야 해요. 주절이 was이므로 can't가 아니라 couldn't를 써야 의미가 같아져요. 나머지는 시제와 can/can't가 모두 알맞아요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) It was wise of you to save some money.
(b) It is impossible of him to finish the work by noon.
(c) The girl was old enough to ride the roller coaster.
(d) This box is too heavy for me to lift it.
(e) It was kind of the driver to wait for us.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. wise는 성품형용사라 of you가 맞아요. (b) 틀림. impossible은 성품형용사가 아니므로 for him이 되어야 해요. (c) 옳음. 형용사 + enough to가 맞아요. (d) 틀림. lift의 목적어는 주어 This box라서 it을 쓰면 안 돼요. (e) 옳음. kind는 성품형용사라 of the driver가 맞아요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) It is hard for her to wake up early in winter.
(b) The kids were too excited to fall asleep.
(c) It was polite for the guests to bring flowers.
(d) The coat is enough warm to wear in January.
(e) It was silly of him to believe the rumor.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. hard는 for her가 맞아요. (b) 옳음. too + 형용사 + to부정사가 맞아요. (c) 틀림. polite는 성품형용사라 of the guests여야 해요. (d) 틀림. enough는 형용사 뒤에 와서 warm enough가 돼야 해요. (e) 옳음. silly는 of him이 맞아요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (d) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) The problem was too difficult for the beginners to solve.
(b) It was cruel of the king to punish the poor farmers.
(c) The singer is famous enough to be recognized anywhere.
(d) It is important for us to keep our promises.
(e) The shop was too crowded for we to walk through.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 주어 The problem이 solve의 목적어라서 it이 없어도 맞아요. (b) 옳음. cruel은 of the king이 맞아요. (c) 옳음. 형용사 + enough to + 수동형도 맞아요. (d) 옳음. important는 for us가 맞아요. (e) 틀림. for 뒤의 의미상 주어는 목적격 us여야 해요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (e) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것만을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) It was nice of Jisu to lend me an umbrella.
(b) It is difficult of me to understand his accent.
(c) The tea was cool enough for the baby to drink.
(d) My brother is too young to drive a car.
(e) He was tall enough to reaching the ceiling.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. nice는 of Jisu가 맞아요. (b) 틀림. difficult는 for me여야 해요. (c) 옳음. 형용사 + enough + for 의미상 주어 + to가 맞아요. (d) 옳음. too young to drive가 맞아요. (e) 틀림. enough 뒤에는 to reach(to부정사)를 써야 해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것만을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) It is natural for babies to cry.
(b) It was stupid of me to leave my wallet at home.
(c) He studied hard enough to pass the exam.
(d) The shoes were too small for him wear.
(e) It was rude for the waiter to ignore us.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. natural은 for babies가 맞아요. (b) 옳음. stupid는 of me가 맞아요. (c) 옳음. 부사 + enough to가 맞아요. (d) 틀림. to wear처럼 to부정사의 to가 빠졌어요. (e) 틀림. rude는 성품형용사라 of the waiter여야 해요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것만을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The snow was so deep that we couldn't walk.
(b) The test was so hard that nobody could not finish it.
(c) It was careless of Tom to leave the window open.
(d) The room is too small for ten people to sleep in.
(e) She is too proud to ask for help.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. so ~ that 구문에서 시제가 맞아요. (b) 틀림. nobody 자체가 부정이라 could not이 아니라 could여야 해요. (c) 옳음. careless는 of Tom이 맞아요. (d) 옳음. 전치사 in의 목적어가 주어 The room이라 맞아요. (e) 옳음. too + 형용사 + to부정사가 맞아요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
It was brave (A) the boy to tell the truth.
The exam was too hard (B) us to finish in an hour.
items.exp: brave는 성품형용사라 (A)는 of예요. too hard 뒤의 의미상 주어는 일반 형용사이므로 for us가 돼요.

items.q:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
It was silly (A) me to forget the key.
The coat is warm (B) to wear in winter.
items.exp: silly는 성품형용사라 of me예요. 따뜻해서 겨울에 입을 수 있다는 뜻이므로 warm enough to가 알맞아요. too는 '너무 ~해서 ~할 수 없다'라 어색해요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 for의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> It is difficult [for] me to remember so many names.
choices: I bought a scarf [for] my sister.
She has lived in Busan [for] five years.
It was dangerous [for] the child to cross the street alone.
items.exp: <보기>의 for는 to부정사의 의미상 주어(me)를 이끄는 for예요. 정답 문장의 for the child도 cross의 행위자를 나타내요. 나머지는 대상, 이유, 기간, 감사의 이유를 나타내요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 enough의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> He is tall [enough] to ride the ride.
choices: There is [enough] water in the bottle.
She played well [enough] to win the prize.
Is there [enough] time to finish the test?
I have [enough] money for the ticket.
We bought [enough] rice for ten people.
items.exp: <보기>의 enough는 형용사 tall을 꾸미는 부사예요. 정답 문장도 부사 well을 꾸미는 부사예요. 나머지는 명사 앞에서 '충분한'의 뜻으로 쓰인 한정사예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 소년이 낯선 사람을 도와준 것은 친절했다.
a: kind of the boy to help
items.exp: kind는 성품형용사라 의미상 주어를 of the boy로 쓰고 to help를 이어요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 이 문제는 아이들이 풀기에는 너무 어렵다.
a: too difficult for kids to solve
too difficult for children to solve
items.exp: too ~ to 구문이고 의미상 주어는 for kids예요. solve의 목적어는 주어 This problem이라 it은 쓰지 않아요.

items.q: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: The boy was so weak that he couldn't lift the bag.
items.exp: so ~ that ~ can't는 too ~ to로 바꿀 수 있어요.

items.q: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Sue is so brave that she can ride the roller coaster alone.
items.s: Sue is ___ the roller coaster alone.
items.exp: so ~ that ~ can은 형용사 + enough to로 바꿀 수 있어요. enough는 형용사 뒤에 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: It was rude [for] him to ignore the guests. → ___
a: It was rude of him to ignore the guests
items.exp: rude는 성품형용사라 의미상 주어를 of him으로 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: My little brother is [enough old] to ride the bus alone. → ___
a: old enough to ride the bus alone
is old enough to ride the bus alone
My little brother is old enough to ride the bus alone
items.exp: enough는 형용사 old 뒤에 와서 old enough가 돼요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Learning new languages is not always easy.
Tom is busy preparing for the science fair.
They are looking forward to meeting the author.
Making friends in a new school take some time.
She spent two hours fixing her bike.
items.exp: 동명사구가 주어이면 단수 취급해야 해요. 가까이 있는 school에 끌리지 말고 take를 takes로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
choices: The children are busy to decorate the classroom.
How about taking a walk along the river after dinner?
I'm sorry for not to call you yesterday.
My uncle goes fish every Sunday.
Playing computer games are bad for your eyes.
items.exp: How about 뒤에는 동명사를 써요. busy 뒤는 decorating, 동명사의 부정은 not calling, go fishing, 동명사 주어는 단수라서 is가 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
choices: My grandmother is looking forward to visit us next week.
Her dream is becoming a famous chef.
We had difficulty finding the way to the hotel.
Eating too much sugar causes many health problems.
He is proud of winning the first prize.
items.exp: look forward to에서 to는 전치사라서 뒤에 동명사가 와야 해요. visit을 visiting으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법에 맞는 문장은?
choices: Jenny is good at to draw animals.
Spending time with family make me happy.
We were sorry for never answering your messages.
How about to try the new pizza place?
I am sorry for don't telling you.
items.exp: 동명사의 부정은 앞에 not이나 never를 써요. 전치사 at 뒤에는 drawing, 동명사 주어는 단수라 makes, How about 뒤에는 trying, don't telling은 not telling이 되어야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Writing letters by hand is becoming rare.
(b) The children are busy to decorate the classroom.
(c) My little sister spends too much time playing games.
(d) I look forward to meet my pen pal in July.
(e) What about to visit the science museum on Sunday?
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 동명사 주어는 단수 취급해 is가 맞아요. (b) 틀림. be busy 뒤에는 decorating이 와야 해요. (c) 옳음. spend 시간 -ing 형태가 맞아요. (d) 틀림. to는 전치사라 meeting이어야 해요. (e) 틀림. What about 뒤에는 visiting이 와야 해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Cleaning the windows takes more than an hour.
(b) The students have difficulty understanding the poem.
(c) My cousin goes ski every winter.
(d) Are you afraid of meet new people?
(e) He thanked us for not forget his birthday.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 동명사 주어에 단수 동사 takes가 맞아요. (b) 옳음. have difficulty -ing가 맞아요. (c) 틀림. go -ing 형태로 goes skiing이어야 해요. (d) 틀림. 전치사 of 뒤에는 meeting이 와야 해요. (e) 틀림. 전치사 for 뒤 동명사의 부정은 not forgetting이에요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (d), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Collecting stamps was my grandfather's hobby.
(b) She is worried about losing her phone again.
(c) We spent the weekend cleaning the garage.
(d) My teacher's job is correcting our essays and giving advice.
(e) Reading books on the bus make me sleepy.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 동명사 주어가 단수라 was가 맞아요. (b) 옳음. 전치사 about 뒤 동명사가 맞아요. (c) 옳음. spend 시간 -ing가 맞아요. (d) 옳음. 보어 자리에 동명사 두 개가 병렬로 맞아요. (e) 틀림. 동명사 주어는 단수라 makes여야 해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (d) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것만을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Cooking for ten people were harder than I thought.
(b) We are thinking about going camping this weekend.
(c) He is busy to clean his room.
(d) Never giving up is the secret of her success.
(e) I'm tired of eating the same food every day.
items.exp: (a) 틀림. 동명사 주어는 단수라 was여야 해요. (b) 옳음. 전치사 뒤 동명사와 go -ing가 맞아요. (c) 틀림. be busy 뒤에는 cleaning이어야 해요. (d) 옳음. 동명사의 부정에 never를 앞에 쓰고 단수 is가 맞아요. (e) 옳음. 전치사 of 뒤 동명사가 맞아요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (b), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것만을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) They had difficulty in finding a parking space.
(b) I look forward to see you soon.
(c) How about asking the teacher for some advice?
(d) My father spends most weekends repairing old clocks.
(e) She is angry about not inviting to the party.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. have difficulty (in) -ing에서 in은 생략 가능해 맞아요. (b) 틀림. to가 전치사라 seeing이어야 해요. (c) 옳음. How about -ing가 맞아요. (d) 옳음. spend 시간 -ing가 맞아요. (e) 틀림. '초대받지 못한 것'이므로 수동 동명사 not being invited가 되어야 해요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것만을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Buying cheap shoes often cost more in the end.
(b) Sue is worried about being late for the interview.
(c) The twins went shopping after school.
(d) My plan for this year is not wasting time on useless things.
(e) She is interested in work for an animal shelter.
items.exp: (a) 틀림. 동명사 주어는 단수라 costs여야 해요. (b) 옳음. 전치사 about 뒤 being late가 맞아요. (c) 옳음. go -ing가 맞아요. (d) 옳음. 보어 자리 동명사의 부정이 맞아요. (e) 틀림. 전치사 in 뒤에는 working이어야 해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (b), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
I'm looking forward (A) you again.
We spent the whole day (B) the garden.
items.exp: look forward to에서 to는 전치사라 seeing이 와요. spend 시간 뒤에는 -ing가 와서 cleaning이에요.

items.q:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) the piano every day is not easy for a beginner.
My brother is good at (B) cartoons.
items.exp: (A)는 문장의 주어라서 동명사 Practicing이 알맞아요. (B)는 전치사 at의 목적어라서 drawing이 와요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 to의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> She is looking forward [to] meeting her cousins.
choices: My sister is used [to] getting up early.
We decided [to] sell the old car.
I have a lot of homework [to] finish today.
He went to the market [to] buy some eggs.
items.exp: <보기>의 to는 뒤에 동명사가 오는 전치사 to예요. 정답의 be used to -ing의 to도 전치사예요. 나머지는 동사원형 앞의 to부정사예요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 동명사의 역할이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> Her hobby is [collecting] old coins.
choices: My job is [teaching] kids to swim.
items.exp: <보기>의 collecting은 보어예요. 정답의 teaching도 주어 My job을 설명하는 보어예요. 나머지는 각각 주어, 동사의 목적어, 전치사의 목적어예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그녀는 그 보고서를 쓰느라 바빴다.
items.exp: be busy -ing는 '~하느라 바쁘다'예요. 과거이므로 was busy writing이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그들은 그 새 영화를 보기를 고대하고 있다.
items.exp: look forward to의 to는 전치사라서 seeing을 써요. 현재진행형이므로 are looking forward to seeing이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 새 쿠키 조리법을 시도해 보는 게 어때?
items.exp: How/What about 뒤에는 동명사를 써요.

items.q: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: He was sorry that he didn't keep his promise.
items.s: He was sorry for ___ his promise.
items.exp: 전치사 for 뒤에서 동명사의 부정은 not이나 never를 동명사 앞에 써요. didn't에 해당하므로 not keeping이에요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: I'm looking forward to [see] you soon. → ___
a: I'm looking forward to seeing you soon
I am looking forward to seeing you soon
items.exp: look forward to의 to는 전치사라서 동명사 seeing이 와야 해요.

items.q: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그녀는 축제 포스터를 디자인하느라 오후 내내 보냈다.
items.s: She spent the whole afternoon ___ a poster for the festival.
items.exp: spend 시간 -ing 형태라서 designing이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Tom promised to return the book by Friday.
She gave up to learn the violin after a month.
Do you mind closing the window?
They decided not to move to another city.
The kids kept asking for more candy.
items.exp: give up은 동명사를 목적어로 취하므로 giving up learning처럼 learn은 learning이어야 해요. 나머지는 promise/decide는 to부정사, mind/keep은 동명사를 바르게 썼어요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법에 맞는 문장은?
choices: He avoided to look at the camera.
Nora hopes passing the driving test this time.
I quit to eat fast food last year.
We expect to arrive at the station before noon.
Jake decided not going to the party.
items.exp: expect는 to부정사를 목적어로 취해요. avoid와 quit은 동명사, hope는 to부정사를 쓰고, to부정사의 부정은 not to go예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 문장은?
choices: I clearly remember locking the door before I left.
She forgot to bring her umbrella, so she got wet.
Remember to take your medicine after dinner.
He will never forget winning the first prize.
Don't forget turning off the stove before you leave.
items.exp: 떠나기 전에 해야 할 일은 앞으로 할 일이므로 forget to turn off가 되어야 해요. 나머지는 과거의 일은 -ing, 앞으로 할 일은 to부정사로 바르게 썼어요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 문장은?
choices: My brother is good at playing chess and to solve puzzles.
She is afraid of to speak English in class.
Learning to ride a bike takes time.
He enjoys to read comics on the bus.
Anna promised not telling anyone the secret.
items.exp: Learning(동명사 주어)은 단수 취급하고 목적어 자리의 learn은 to ride를 써서 맞아요. 나머지는 병렬은 solving, 전치사 뒤는 speaking, enjoy 뒤는 reading, promise 뒤는 not to tell이어야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Mina agreed to help us with the project.
(b) I don't mind waiting for you outside.
(c) They practiced to dance on the stage every day.
(d) We plan visiting our grandparents in May.
(e) She learned to swim when she was five.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. agree는 to부정사를 목적어로 취해요. (b) 옳음. mind는 동명사를 목적어로 취해요. (c) 틀림. practice는 동명사를 취해 dancing이어야 해요. (d) 틀림. plan은 to부정사를 취해 to visit이어야 해요. (e) 옳음. learn은 to부정사를 목적어로 취해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Please remember to send the email to Mr. Kim tomorrow.
(b) I'll never forget to meet the president last year.
(c) He tried to carry all the bags at once, but they were too heavy.
(d) The little boy started crying loudly.
(e) Did you finish to write the report?
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 내일 보낼 일이므로 remember to send가 맞아요. (b) 틀림. 작년에 만난 일이므로 forget meeting이어야 해요. (c) 옳음. 한꺼번에 들려고 애썼다는 뜻이라 try to가 맞아요. (d) 옳음. start는 동명사도 to부정사도 목적어로 취해요. (e) 틀림. finish는 동명사를 취해 writing이어야 해요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (e) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Sam avoided to answer the question.
(b) I hope seeing you again soon.
(c) She keeps forgetting her password.
(d) We decided not waiting for the late bus.
(e) He quit to play the game after the accident.
items.exp: (a) 틀림. avoid는 동명사를 취해 answering이어야 해요. (b) 틀림. hope는 to부정사를 취해 to see여야 해요. (c) 옳음. keep은 동명사를 목적어로 취해요. (d) 틀림. to부정사의 부정은 not to wait여야 해요. (e) 틀림. quit은 동명사를 취해 playing이어야 해요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (a), (b), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것만을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Why did you give up to learn the cello?
(b) My parents promised to take me to the zoo.
(c) He kept practicing the speech in front of the mirror.
(d) I forgot taking the keys, so I couldn't open the door.
(e) She expects to hear from the company this week.
items.exp: (a) 틀림. give up은 동명사를 취해 learning이어야 해요. (b) 옳음. promise는 to부정사를 취해요. (c) 옳음. keep과 practice 뒤에 동명사가 맞아요. (d) 틀림. 가져오는 것을 잊은 것이므로 forgot to take여야 해요. (e) 옳음. expect는 to부정사를 취해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (b), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것만을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Do you mind to open the window?
(b) The students began to read quietly.
(c) I remember to see this movie two years ago.
(d) Tom is learning to cook Italian food.
(e) We tried to push the car, but it didn't move.
items.exp: (a) 틀림. mind는 동명사를 취해 opening이어야 해요. (b) 옳음. begin은 to부정사도 가능해요. (c) 틀림. 과거에 본 일이므로 remember seeing이어야 해요. (d) 옳음. learn은 to부정사를 취해요. (e) 옳음. 밀려고 애썼다는 뜻이라 try to가 맞아요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (a), (c)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것만을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) He decided not to tell his parents about the test.
(b) She tried drinking warm milk, but she still couldn't sleep.
(c) They agreed to meet at the library after school.
(d) I avoided to tell him the truth.
(e) Don't forget closing the windows before you go to bed.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. to부정사의 부정은 not to tell이에요. (b) 옳음. 시험 삼아 마셔 본 것이라 try -ing가 맞아요. (c) 옳음. agree는 to부정사를 취해요. (d) 틀림. avoid는 동명사를 취해 telling이어야 해요. (e) 틀림. 앞으로 할 일이므로 forget to close여야 해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c)예요.

items.q:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Kate hopes (A) a pilot, and she practices (B) English every day.
items.exp: hope는 to부정사를 취해 (A)는 to become이에요. practice는 동명사를 취해 (B)는 speaking이에요.

items.q:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Don't forget (A) some milk on your way home.
I clearly remember (B) the milk in the fridge yesterday.
items.exp: 앞으로 할 일을 잊지 말라는 뜻이므로 (A)는 to buy예요. 어제 넣어 둔 과거의 일을 기억한다는 뜻이므로 (B)는 putting이에요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 부분의 의미가 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> He tried [to open] the jar, but it was too tight.
choices: I tried [adding] salt to the soup.
Why don't you try [using] a different key?
She tried [wearing] a red dress for a change.
She tried [to lift] the box, but it was too heavy.
items.exp: <보기>의 try to open은 '열려고 애썼다'는 뜻이에요. 정답의 try to lift도 '들려고 애썼다'예요. 나머지 try -ing는 '시험 삼아 ~해 보다'예요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 부분의 의미가 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> I'll never forget [visiting] Jeju with my family.
choices: She remembers [seeing] the actor at the airport.
Remember [to bring] your ID card tomorrow.
Don't forget [to turn] off the lights.
I forgot [to buy] milk, so I went back.
Please remember [to call] your aunt tonight.
items.exp: <보기>의 forget visiting은 이미 다녀온 일을 잊지 않는다는 뜻이에요. 정답의 remember seeing도 이미 본 일을 기억한다는 뜻이에요. 나머지는 해야 할 일에 대한 to부정사예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 우리는 사진을 찍기 위해 걸음을 멈췄다.
items.exp: '~하기 위해 멈추다'는 stop + to부정사(부사적 용법)로 써요. 과거이므로 stopped to take예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그는 어제 책상 위에 그 책을 두었던 것을 기억한다.
items.exp: 이미 한 일을 기억하는 것이므로 remember + 동명사예요. 주어가 He이고 현재이므로 remembers leaving the book이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그녀는 다시는 거짓말을 하지 않겠다고 약속했다.
items.exp: promise는 to부정사를 취하고, to부정사의 부정은 to 앞에 not을 써서 promised not to lie예요.

items.q: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Don't forget that you must call Mom tonight.
items.exp: 앞으로 할 일을 잊지 말라는 뜻이므로 forget + to부정사예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: Mina decided [not going] to the party. → ___
a: Mina decided not to go to the party
items.exp: decide는 to부정사를 취하고, 부정은 to 앞에 not을 써서 not to go예요.

items.q: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 미안해. 네 책을 가져오는 것을 잊었어. 내일 가져올게.
items.s: I'm sorry. I forgot ___ your book, so I'll bring it tomorrow.
items.exp: 가져와야 할 일을 하지 못한 것이므로 forget + to부정사예요.

units.name: Ch7-1 현재분사와 과거분사 · 분사의 형용사적 쓰임

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: The man wearing a red cap is my uncle.
Look at the sleeping puppy under the table.
The boy teasing by his classmates looked sad.
She picked up a fallen leaf from the ground.
The windows broken by the storm were replaced.
items.exp: 소년은 놀림을 '당하는' 수동 관계이므로 과거분사 teased를 써야 해요. 나머지는 능동 wearing, 진행 sleeping, 완료 fallen, 수동 broken을 바르게 썼어요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법에 맞는 문장은?
choices: He bought a made in Korea bag.
The soldiers wounding in the battle were treated at the camp.
She is reading a book writing in French.
The kids looked exciting at the fireworks.
We watched the children playing in the snow.
items.exp: watch + 목적어 + 현재분사로 '~하고 있는 것을 보다'가 돼요. made in Korea처럼 분사 + α는 명사 뒤에 와야 하고, wounded, written, excited가 되어야 나머지가 맞아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 문장은?
choices: He kept the lights turning on all night.
